name: Shiori
message: "I hope Tetsuya-san is still around..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems he has business with us as well."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There he is, over there."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now please, if you would."
"Hello."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Hm? Oh, thank goodness, it's you. I'm glad I caught you."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I still haven't properly thanked you. I figured you might come back, so I waited here."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Good thing you did. I was just about to head home. Thank you, for Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It feels like a weight has been lifted from my chest... My heart feels so much lighter now. Thank you, truly."

name: Tetsuya
message: "We made a new promise as well. I'll try writing, in my own way—a story that portrays the Tomoko-san who lives within me."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She told me she'd wait, after all."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Is Tomoko-san there? She told me she'd help you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please tell Tetsuya-san to take out a pen and paper and place them on the bench."
(Tell him what she said)

name: Tetsuya
message: "Ah, yes, of course. So Tomoko-san really is there. Just a moment."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Um... would this be alright?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It really is inconvenient not being able to speak directly..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "...'Answer these questions. Don't ask why'?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Writing back and forth like this is far too inefficient. I'll leave the rest to you."

name: Shiori
message: "It might be best if we narrow it down to just one question."

name: Shiori
message: "I know you've got a lot of questions, but we should focus on the abduction case for now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "What would you like to ask?"
"Do you know about past abduction cases?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "Huh? Abduction cases?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I know of a few. Could you be a little more specific?"
"The one with the stroller..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Ah... that one. It was such a tragic incident, I remember it well."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I no longer had the drive to write back then, but perhaps my reporter's curiosity was still there."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I don't know if I'll be able to answer, but please, go ahead and ask."
"I want to hear the details of the incident she caused."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It's not something I can talk about lightly, but..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "......You've helped me a great deal. I suppose it's only right that I repay the favor."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And I'm sure you're not pursuing this just for thrills or curiosity, right?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'll tell you what I know. I'm curious as to why you'd want to know about this, but I'll refrain from asking."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Should I start with why the incident occurred, and go from there?"
"Please do."

name: Tetsuya
message: "The suspect got pregnant during her second or third year of high school."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Naturally, it turned into a huge mess... If the father had even a little sense of responsibility, things might have turned out differently. Unfortunately, that wasn't the case."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Apparently, he was a college student. After she told him about the pregnancy, he cut off all contact and ran away."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I heard her relatives kept urging her to get an abortion. They were probably worried about her future."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But she never said yes."

name: Tetsuya
message: "While all that was going on, it reached a point where she had no choice but to give birth."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And so the child was born. The child was born, but..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Maybe it was because the people around her didn't understand her, or because the man she trusted fled from his responsibility... Maybe all that stress just kept piling up..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But it was a stillbirth. By the time the child was born, it was already..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...How awful..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She ended up falling mentally ill... apparently to the point where she was almost bedridden."

name: Tetsuya
message: "They say she'd just lie in bed all day, staring into space. She wouldn't even eat, so they had to force her to."

name: Tetsuya
message: "The next time I heard anything about her was two years ago."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It turned into a police matter. Apparently, she tried to pull a child about the same age away from the real mother, telling the child to go home with her."

name: Tetsuya
message: "In her mind, she'd given birth to her daughter, and the child was growing up healthy and strong. That was simply how it played out in her head."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She convinced herself that her child had been taken away from her, and wandered around this area because of that."

name: Tetsuya
message: "They couldn't hold her criminally responsible, so it didn't become a crime."

name: Tetsuya
message: "If her child were still alive today... she'd probably be around three years old by now. Not an age where a kid could be wandering around on their own."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But she kept searching for her child every single day."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. So the abduction incident was around two years ago..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Apparently, she'd panic if shut in her room. She'd scream about her daughter being gone."

name: Tetsuya
message: "In desperation, her relatives tried giving her a baby doll... which finally seemed to calm her down."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She started taking the doll out in a stroller for walks. People around her stared, but it was far better than her causing another incident."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And that brings us to the present. I have no intention of turning this into an article."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'm sick of writing pieces that just wear people down."

name: Tetsuya
message: "...I guess that's about all I can tell you."
"Thank you."

name: Tetsuya
message: "You're welcome. I hope it helped."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'd like you to keep this to yourselves. After all, her relatives must be suffering too. But knowing you, I'm sure you won't go around carelessly spreading this around."

name: Tetsuya
message: "The woman in this story is still alive. I hope she can recover someday."

name: Tetsuya
message:
"......
Was that all? Are you good now?"
"Yes."
"We're good now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I see. Well then, I should get going now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I don't know what it is you have to do, but good luck. And Tomoko-san too... um, well, tell her I said we should talk again sometime."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Yes.  We should."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Goodbye."
"Goodbye."
"Thank you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That was truly worth hearing."

name: Shiori
message: "We were tied by fate. Just as you said, every encounter we've had until now has had meaning."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now then, Buddy. Have you come around to my tie theory?"
"Amazing."
"Our supreme prophet!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course, of course it is."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hehehe... Praise from others does feel good. Perhaps I should compile it into a paper and present it at a conference."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Apologies. I got a little carried away back there. That wasn't very rational of me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Seeing how much your eyes are sparkling, I assume you were sincerely praising me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A prophet, is it? Hearing that made me realize that what I call a theory is really nothing more than occultism."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Sorry. I was just a little discouraged. I'm fine. It was only a little."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Allow me to pull myself together. Now, shall we go over what Tetsuya-san said?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, let's."

name: Shiori
message: "We now know that Rina-san was indeed responsible for an abduction incident. It even became a police matter."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, it happened two years ago, after reports on the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case had already stopped."

name: Shiori
message: "Therefore, Rina-san cannot be Girl A."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I hate to say this about Rina-san, but to be honest... I was hoping she would turn out to be Girl A."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If Rina-san had been Girl A, that would've meant Kugayama-san and Gyaruko-san were unrelated to the case."

name: Shiori
message: "But in the end, Rina-san was the unrelated one."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "At this point, it is extremely likely that either Kugayama-san or Gyaruko-san is, in fact, Girl A."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Of course, there is still the possibility that it's someone we don't know."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, by following the ties we've formed, many things have been brought to light."

name: Shiori
message: "The answer lies beyond those ties. Since that is the case, then we should act on it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed, the question is: Which of them is Girl A?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yasuda claims that Kugayama-san killed Yasuda, the children, and her own younger sister."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If his claim were true, then Kugayama-san would be the real culprit behind the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case."

name: Shiori
message: "...Yes. That... would be the case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But I should add that while it is unclear whether Gyaruko-san is directly involved in the case... there are many suspicious aspects to her words and actions."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She called herself Kirishiki Nagisa. Was it simply a case of mistaken identity, or was it a deliberate lie?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In reality, there is a strong possibility that she is actually Aoi Lumina. And if we are to believe the testimony of the real Kirishiki-san..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Then Gyaruko-san killed her close friend, Kirishiki-san, and made it look like a suicide."

name: Shiori
message: "...And the one who brought Yasuda and me together was also—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Indeed, it was Gyaruko-san."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Did she learn about Yasuda by chance, or were they acquainted when she was alive?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And did she tell Kugayama-san about Yasuda with some kind of intent in mind?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, this is nothing more than speculation... or wishful thinking, even. We simply do not have any evidence."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That said, it is no longer possible to gather any more proof. It's an unsolved case, after all. There is no one left who would know."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The police might have evidence and the like. However, barging in and investigating it ourselves simply isn't realistic."

name: Shiori
message: "At the very least, I'd love to get a little more information about the case..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...No. What matters is that we have something that can reassure Kugayama-san that she isn't the culprit. It doesn't necessarily have to be hard evidence..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In that case..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That gossiping woman... It might be worth hearing her out."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "An unexpected testimony has come up. Perhaps it will bring us closer to the truth. No, it definitely will."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. We've been steadily progressing by following our ties so far."

name: Shiori
message: "We should try talking to her, then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now, let us go. The end is at hand."
